lede: The Ethics Commission meets Tuesday to draft a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town Council — a direct follow-up to its May finding, and the kind of structural accountability question that tends to get decided quietly if nobody's paying attention. Alongside that, the County is digging into child care assistance funding and its budget implications on Wednesday, the Hospital District board takes up the two-site model for the new facility on Thursday, and TMVOA moves to stand up a Workforce Housing Committee. Busy week on the governance side.

notable.stake: Commission drafts Code of Conduct for town officials — shapes future accountability rules.
County examines CCAP budget impact; child care funding cuts could affect working families.
Hospital board may act on two-site facility model, shaping the new medical center's scope and location.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and adopt updated policies.
